title: 第222章 制造巨龙组建龙骑军第221章 新奖励龙之血裔
slug: 是攻略系统不是攻城略地系统
content_zh:
地狱空间，前哨城堡之中。
由超凡扈从骑士们的力量所驱动的守护魔法阵，散发圣洁之力驱散一切邪恶地狱气息，让地狱生物不敢窥觎城堡。
超凡扈从骑士们更是主动出击，轮番组队外出猎杀各类地狱魔物，然后将它们的尸首尽数带了回来。
体内拥有着来自于李凯南【破邪之力】的圣洁力量，让超凡扈从骑士们能够对地狱生物产生克制，猎杀效率极高。
被他们猎杀的地狱魔物尸体，此刻甚至直接堆积成了一座小山……
严格来说，任何生物、东西都可以转化为资源，即便是这些地狱魔物也是如此！
所以此前李凯南打算命令手下超凡者们，去研究如何将地狱魔物们身上邪恶地狱净化干净的办法。
再怎么说，这也是蛋白质啊！
虽然这些地狱魔物们外表长得非常恶心，但做成罐头不就没有这些烦恼了吗？
结果李凯南还没有正式下令研究呢，系统给的新特质奖励【龙之血裔】就来了……
看着面前这些外表奇形怪状还流着绿色脓血，一看就觉得反胃的地狱魔物们，李凯南耸了耸肩。
也行吧，这些玩意真做成罐头给民众补充蛋白质，李凯南自己多少也有些过意不去。
李凯南当即抬起手来，发动了【龙之血裔】的效果。
下一刻便有耀眼的赤色光辉骤然从他的手中亮起，颜色艳红如焚天熔浆，刹那间冲破周遭昏暗。
旋即这耀眼的赤色光辉直接凝聚出一枚又一枚深邃难懂，散放着强大龙威的古朴玄奥文字。
无数龙文密密麻麻凌空交织一起，然后直接化成了一座恢弘繁琐的龙文法阵。
那环环相扣的龙文泛着赤色光芒，堆积成一座小山的地狱魔物尸首都不受控制地腾空而起，然后尽数被这道龙文法阵所吞没。
无数地狱魔物们的血肉，在法阵的淬炼之下快速消融，化作了源源不断的养料朝法阵的最中央疯狂汇聚。
原本由那些龙文所散发着的龙族威慑，此刻变得越发凝实了起来。
法阵之中，三头浑身覆满赤红鳞甲的巨龙身影由虚变实。

最后更是彻底显化出实体来，拍打着翅膀自法阵中挣脱而出，齐齐仰头发出了振聋发聩、响彻地狱上空的龙吟之声！
旋即这三头红色巨龙身形缓缓落到李凯南的面前，身体直接趴在了地上，用最为卑微的姿势表达了它们的臣服和忠诚。
李凯南见状，仔细打量着面前这三头红色巨龙。
吞噬了数量惊人的地狱魔物血肉，然后借由【龙之血裔】所打造出来的三头巨龙，无论是体型还是拥有的力量都明显比奥罗拉逊色不少。
可即便如此，它们也依旧是力量强大、位属高阶魔法生物的巨龙！
这三头巨龙的力量，都要比李凯南最近招募的那些超凡者们还要强大。
在李凯南的麾下，这三头巨龙恐怕也就仅次于得到了仙子冠冕加持的莱拉克、布兰妮以及奥罗拉这几个顶级战力。
果然，系统奖励就没有差的。
而且最为关键的是，【龙之血裔】这个特质能够帮助李凯南在攻略地狱空间的同时，将地狱之中的魔物们化作自己的力量！
想到这里，李凯南直接招来了三名超凡扈从骑士，然后分别将这三头红色巨龙分配给了他们。
content_en:
Hell space, in the outpost castle.
The protective magic circle driven by the power of the extraordinary knights exudes holy power to drive away all evil hell breath, so that hell creatures dare not peek into the castle.
The extraordinary retinue knights even took the initiative, taking turns to form teams to hunt down all kinds of hell monsters, and then brought back all their corpses.
Possessing the holy power from Li Kainan's [Evil-Destroying Power] in their bodies, the extraordinary knights can restrain hellish creatures and hunt with extremely high efficiency.
The corpses of the hell monsters they hunted were even piled up into a hill at this moment...
Strictly speaking, any creature or thing can be converted into resources, even these hell monsters!
Therefore, Li Kainan planned to order his extraordinary beings to study how to purify the evil hell from the hell monsters.
After all, this is protein!
Although these hell monsters look very disgusting, wouldn’t they be free of these troubles if they were made into cans?
As a result, before Li Kainan officially ordered the research, the new trait reward [Dragon Bloodline] given by the system has arrived...
Li Kainan shrugged as he looked at the strange-looking hell monsters in front of him that were bleeding with green pus and blood and made him feel sick to his stomach.
That's okay. These things are really made into cans to supplement protein for the people. Li Kainan himself feels a little guilty.
Li Kainan immediately raised his hand and activated the effect of [Dragon Bloodline].
The next moment, a dazzling red light suddenly lit up from his hand, the color was as bright as burning magma, breaking through the surrounding darkness in an instant.
Immediately, this dazzling red light directly condensed into one after another profound and incomprehensible ancient and mysterious words, exuding powerful dragon power.
Countless dragon scripts were densely intertwined in the air, and then directly transformed into a magnificent and complicated dragon script formation.
The interlocking dragon inscriptions glowed with red light, and the corpses of hell monsters piled up into a hill rose into the air uncontrollably, and then they were all swallowed up by the dragon inscriptions formation.
The flesh and blood of countless hell monsters quickly melted under the tempering of the magic circle, turning into a steady stream of nutrients that gathered crazily towards the center of the magic circle.
The dragon's intimidation originally exuded by those dragon inscriptions became more and more solid at this moment.
In the magic circle, the figures of three giant dragons covered with red scales changed from virtual to real.
In the end, they completely manifested themselves, flapping their wings and breaking free from the magic circle. They all raised their heads and let out a deafening dragon roar that resounded through the sky above hell!
Immediately, the three giant red dragons slowly fell in front of Li Kainan and lay directly on the ground, expressing their submission and loyalty in the most humble posture.
Seeing this, Li Kainan carefully looked at the three red dragons in front of him.
The three-headed dragon that devoured an astonishing amount of hell monster flesh and blood, and then used the [Dragon Bloodline] to create it, was obviously inferior to Aurora in terms of size and power.
But even so, they are still powerful dragons that are high-level magical creatures!
The power of these three giant dragons is even more powerful than the extraordinary beings Li Kainan recently recruited.
Under Li Kainan's command, these three giant dragons are probably second only to the top combat forces of Lilac, Britney and Aurora who have been blessed by the fairy crown.
Sure enough, the system rewards are not bad.
And the most important thing is that the trait of [Dragon Bloodline] can help Li Kainan turn the monsters in hell into his own power while conquering the hell space!
Thinking of this, Li Kainan directly recruited three extraordinary knights, and then assigned the three red dragons to them respectively.
